701-program-requirements: 120 credits (150 with Foundation) leading to certification to teach ages 5 to 11, with academic, professional and pedagogy courses and a school practicum every year. McGill recommends graduates to the Ministry.
701-foundation-program: 30 credits in U0: introductions to elementary subjects and fields like sociology or psychology, maybe a First Year Seminar. Choose with your adviser. FRSL needs placement tests, and any 100–200 ANTH, ENGL, GEOG, HIST, POLI, PSYC, RELG or SOCI is recommended. Check prerequisites.
702-kindergarten-and-elementary-teaching: Both Methods courses may be Art, Drama or Music. EDSL 447 needs EDSL 350.
702-kindergarten-and-elementary-educatio: With your adviser: 9 credits in teachable subjects (Art, English, Culture and Citizenship, French, Math, Music, Natural Sciences, Physical Education, Social Studies), and 3 each from three others. At most 9 in one area. Others with permission.
702-art: Up to 9 from this list and ARTH.
703-culture-and-citizenship-in-quebec: Up to 9; other RELG with permission.
703-french: Up to 9 of FRSL or FREN, or the listed course.
703-mathematics: Up to 9 at 200+. MATH 111 is for Foundation, not for those with CEGEP math.
704-music: Up to 9, or any MUGT, MUHL, MUIT or MUCT. Without a music background, a few Schulich courses with permission. Some need Schulich's permission.
704-physical-education: Up to 9 EDKP with the Department's permission. EDKP 292 is open; the others are restricted.
704-social-studies: Up to 9 from the mix of History, Geography and Citizenship. Other ANTH and SOCI are electives only. Extra History: 3 European, 3 Asian, African or Latin American, 3 any. Some count for either area, not both.
705-program-requirements: 120 credits (150 with Foundation) to certification. Contact OFNIE. Mature students enter U1 without Foundation.
707-elective-courses-6-credits: From listed Subject Area, Methods, or Curriculum and Pedagogy; at most 9 from one area.
707-program-description: The Kindergarten and Elementary program, plus teaching Jewish studies. Build a background in Bible, prayer, holidays and history first. If you can't teach in Hebrew, consider a semester at an Israeli university.
708-kindergarten-and-elementary-subject-: 15 credits from Jewish Studies, chosen with the option's Adviser.
708-program-requirements: 30 credits of French and second language education within the regular B.Ed., for French immersion teaching.
709-competency-in-french: Show four years at a French high school or university, three at a French Québec university, or Secondary V and a DEC in French. Otherwise, pass the French Language Placement Test.
709-pedagogie-de-l-immersion-francaise-p: Those from outside Québec may do the Foundation en français, then pass the TFA-PIF.
709-required-courses-108-credits: Register in Bilingual sections, and do at least one Field Experience in French immersion.
710-program-description: Theory and global issues: a 54-credit major, an 18-credit approved minor, and 18 electives, with an internship and applied research. A general degree like Liberal Arts, with no teacher certification.
710-foundation-program: From high school: 30 introductory credits of your choice, verified by an adviser, needed before U1. Have Fall and Winter choices checked by email or at the August session. Advanced Standing may fulfil it.
711-complementary-courses-30-credits: 12 credits from the lists, at most 9 from one; others with approval.
711-children-and-youth: Counts when the topic fits. Approved minors: Management for Non-Management, International Development, or Educational Psychology. A second minor may fill the electives with approval.
712-elective-courses-18-credits: From Education; elsewhere exceptionally with permission.
712-music-education-music-elementary-and: Not currently offered; the B.Ed. Music is open to those with a B.Mus.
712-program-description: Five years to Québec certification, or 170 credits over six for those without CEGEP or similar. 137 credits: 58 Education, 71 Music, 8 electives, excluding the 33-credit Foundation.
B.Mus. builds musicianship and teaching techniques; B.Ed. adds foundations, pedagogy and four field experiences. Those with a B.Mus. apply to the B.Ed. Music.
Jazz stream may take MUJZ 260 with permission and MUJZ 161. MUCO 230 or 261 needs the instructor's permission.
712-prerequisite-courses: 33 credits: 4 of ensemble, 6 of non-music electives, 23 from the list. Auditions and tests can exempt you. A DEC in Music or a past Western music course exempts MUHL 186.
714-program-description: 120 credits (150 with Foundation) to certification: Education with field experiences, English subject courses and 6 electives. Sequencing is strict, so use the Program Overview.
714-foundation-program: 30 credits: introductory English and other fields, maybe a First Year Seminar, chosen with your adviser. FRSL needs placement tests.
715-complementary-language-linguistics-c: WCOM 250 or EDEC 203, not both. 42 credits follow, including one in Shakespeare.
717-unofficial-teachable-subject-area-15: 15 designated credits for Stream 2: Math, Social Sciences or Science and Technology. See an adviser.
717-elective-courses-6-credits: Stream 2 uses 3 elective credits for the second subject's Methods course.
717-program-description: 120 credits (150 with Foundation) to certification. From CEGEP without MATH 133, 140 and 141, make these up extra. Sequencing is strict, so use the Program Overview.
717-foundation-program: 30 credits, including MATH 133, 140 and 141. Others with your adviser; FRSL needs placement tests.
718-secondary-mathematics-subject-area-5: Option 1: 21 required and 30 complementary. Option 2: 21 required, 15 complementary and 15 in another teachable subject.
718-complementary-mathematics-courses: 3 from the first list, in Year 1 or 2; 27 (Option 1) or 12 (Option 2) from the rest. Some pairs can't both count.
719-unofficial-teachable-subject-area-15: 15 designated credits for Option 2. See an adviser.
719-electives-6-credits: With a second subject, use 3 for its Methods course.
719-program-description: 120 credits (150 with Foundation) to certification: Living World, Earth and Space, Material World and Technological World for Québec schools. From CEGEP, have two each of biology, chemistry, math and physics, or make them up. Use the Program Overview.
719-foundation-program-basic-sciences: 29–30 credits of basic science in first year.
719-winter-term: MATH 151 and PHYS 142 are options. See an adviser, based on your background and plans.
720-foundation-program-complementary: For those with Advanced Standing in a science. FRSL needs placement tests.
720-secondary-science-and-technology-51-: Across Material World, Earth and Space, Living World and Technological World. Plan around prerequisites.
